notes: tapFrac is normalised SCREEN space, measured from the top. UI taps are computed from the real RectTransforms over the 1242x2688 canvas reference with the AspectRatioFitter correction applied: SafeArea fills the capture screen, but its child AspecterSA is FitInParent at aspect 1242/2688 = 0.46205 while the Unity AVD is 1080x2400 = 0.45, so the UI layer renders 1080 x 2337.4, letterboxed 31.3 px top and bottom. A UI rect at fraction u of the panel therefore lands at 0.013039 + u * 0.973917 of the screen measured from the bottom, and tapFrac y is one minus that. The TRACK_LEFT step is a world tap, which needs no correction: the camera fills the screen and the steering band is read straight off Screen.height. Route 1 gives a 105 s line clock, so both gameplay frames land inside a live run - the first around ten seconds in and the second around twenty, with the order strip, the cart, the crates and the gesture hint all on screen. The run finishes on the pause card, which is deterministic and does not depend on how the random yard fell.
